ex.en: It took me three hours to do my homework.
ex.zh: 我花了三個小時寫作業。

ex.en: I promised to help my brother with his homework.
ex.zh: 我答應要幫弟弟做功課。

ex.en: The math homework was easier than I had expected.
ex.zh: 那份數學作業比我想像中簡單。

homework.en: school work that a student does at home

homework.zh: do one's homework：事先做好功課、充分準備

ex.en: Do your homework before the job interview.
ex.zh: 面試前要先做好功課。

ex.en: The sales team clearly did their homework on the client.
ex.zh: 業務團隊顯然事先把這位客戶研究得很透徹。

homework.en: to learn the facts you need before doing something

ex.en: Every Tuesday morning the housekeeper vacuums.
ex.zh: 管家每週二早上都會用吸塵器打掃。

ex.en: Please ask the housekeeper for extra towels.
ex.zh: 請向房務人員多要一些毛巾。

housekeeper.en: a person whose job is to clean and take care of a house or hotel

ex.en: What is the hourly rate for parking?
ex.zh: 停車每小時多少錢？

ex.en: Part-time staff are paid an hourly wage.
ex.zh: 兼職人員是領時薪。

hourly.en: happening every sixty minutes, or paid for each sixty minutes

ex.en: Buses leave hourly from the station.
ex.zh: 公車每小時從車站發一班。

ex.en: The data is updated hourly.
ex.zh: 資料每小時更新一次。

ex.en: Call our customer hotline if you have any questions.
ex.zh: 如果有任何問題，請撥打我們的客服專線。

ex.en: The hotline is open 24 hours a day.
ex.zh: 這條專線二十四小時都有人接聽。

hotline.en: a phone line people can call for quick help or information

ex.en: I became a homeowner.
ex.zh: 我成為屋主了。

ex.en: Homeowners must pay property tax every year.
ex.zh: 屋主每年都要繳房屋稅。

ex.en: Many homeowners are installing solar panels.
ex.zh: 許多屋主正在裝設太陽能板。

homeowner.en: a person who owns the house they live in

ex.en: I often slept on that bench when I was homeless.
ex.zh: 我無家可歸的時候，常在那張長椅上睡覺。

ex.en: He is a homeless person.
ex.zh: 他是一名街友。

ex.en: The charity provides meals for homeless people.
ex.zh: 這個慈善機構為無家可歸的人提供餐點。

ex.en: Honestly, I really like you.
ex.zh: 說真的，我真的很喜歡你。

ex.en: Honestly, I also want to learn Japanese.
ex.zh: 老實說，我也想學日語。

honestly.en: used to show you are saying what you really think

ex.en: It is a matter of principle with him to answer your questions honestly.
ex.zh: 誠實回答你的問題，對他來說是原則問題。

ex.en: Please answer the questions honestly.
ex.zh: 請誠實回答問題。

honestly.en: in a way that tells the truth

ex.en: This restaurant serves homemade bread.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳供應自製麵包。

ex.en: Nothing beats my mom's homemade dumplings.
ex.zh: 什麼都比不上我媽親手包的水餃。

homemade.en: made at home and not bought from a shop

ex.en: The sun has just sunk below the horizon.
ex.zh: 太陽剛沉到地平線下。

ex.en: The moon was above the horizon.
ex.zh: 月亮已經升到地平線上方。

ex.en: The sun rose over the horizon.
ex.zh: 太陽從地平線升起。

horizon.en: the line in the distance where the sky seems to meet the land or sea

horizon.zh: 眼界、視野；on the horizon 即將發生

ex.en: Traveling abroad really broadened my horizons.
ex.zh: 出國旅行真的開拓了我的眼界。

ex.en: There are big changes on the horizon.
ex.zh: 重大變化即將到來。

horizon.en: the range of things you know or experience, or something about to happen

ex.en: The audience was hostile to his ideas.
ex.zh: 聽眾對他的想法很反感。

ex.en: She gave me a hostile look.
ex.zh: 她用敵意的眼神看我。

hostile.en: unfriendly and ready to oppose or attack

ex.en: We, ACME Ltd., hereby announce that we will resist with all our strength this hostile takeover.
ex.zh: 我們 ACME 有限公司特此宣布，將全力抵制這項惡意收購。

ex.en: The firm fought off a hostile takeover bid.
ex.zh: 這家公司擊退了一項惡意收購。

hostile.en: against the wishes of the people being bought, as when a company buys another

ex.en: The stripes were horizontal.
ex.zh: 條紋是橫的。

ex.en: Draw a horizontal line across the page.
ex.zh: 在頁面上畫一條水平線。

horizontal.en: flat and level, going from side to side

ex.en: There was open hostility between the two managers.
ex.zh: 兩位經理之間的敵意顯而易見。

ex.en: The new plan met with hostility from staff.
ex.zh: 新計畫遭到員工強烈反對。

ex.en: To my horror, I realized I had left my passport at home.
ex.zh: 我驚恐地發現自己把護照忘在家裡了。

ex.en: She watched in horror as the car slid off the road.
ex.zh: 她驚恐地看著那輛車滑出路面。

horror.en: a feeling of great shock and fear

horror.zh: 恐怖（類型），horror movie 恐怖片

ex.en: I'm going to see a horror film.
ex.zh: 我要去看恐怖電影。

ex.en: My brother likes horror movies.
ex.zh: 我哥哥喜歡恐怖電影。

ex.en: Does Tom like watching horror movies?
ex.zh: Tom 喜歡看恐怖片嗎？

horror.en: a type of story or film meant to scare people

ex.en: You'll learn how to do it sooner or later.
ex.zh: 你遲早會學會怎麼做。

ex.en: How do I get to the station?
ex.zh: 請問車站怎麼去？

ex.en: How are you? Did you have a good trip?
ex.zh: 你好嗎？旅途愉快嗎？

ex.en: How was your weekend?
ex.zh: 你週末過得怎麼樣？

how.en: used to ask about someone's condition or an experience

ex.en: How long have you lived here?
ex.zh: 你在這裡住多久了？

ex.en: How far is the airport from here?
ex.zh: 機場離這裡多遠？

how.en: used to ask about amount, age, length or distance

ex.en: How come you know so much about Japanese history?
ex.zh: 你怎麼會對日本歷史這麼了解？

ex.en: How come you're late again?
ex.zh: 你怎麼又遲到了？

how.en: used to ask the reason for something

ex.en: Many homes were washed away by the flood.
ex.zh: 很多房子被洪水沖走了。

ex.en: Many lost their homes after the earthquake.
ex.zh: 地震後許多人失去了家園。

home.en: the place where a person or family lives

ex.en: I would rather stay at home than go out.
ex.zh: 比起出門，我寧願待在家。

ex.en: I'll be home by seven.
ex.zh: 我七點前會到家。

home.en: to or at the place where you live

ex.en: I work from home on Fridays.
ex.zh: 我星期五在家工作。

ex.en: Many people work from home now.
ex.zh: 現在很多人在家工作。

home.en: to do your job at your house and not at an office

ex.en: Not a few houses were destroyed by the typhoon.
ex.zh: 颱風摧毀了不少房屋。

ex.en: His low salary prevents him from buying the house.
ex.zh: 他薪水低，所以買不起那棟房子。

ex.en: Large houses are not necessarily comfortable to live in.
ex.zh: 大房子不一定住起來舒服。

ex.en: Let's have dinner at my house.
ex.zh: 我們到我家吃晚餐吧。

ex.en: I'll stop by your house tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我明天會順路去你家。

house.en: the place where a particular person lives

ex.en: The new building will house our offices.
ex.zh: 新大樓將作為我們的辦公室。

ex.en: The museum houses over 5,000 paintings.
ex.zh: 這間美術館收藏了五千多幅畫。

house.en: to have enough space for people or things

ex.en: She looks young. However, she's actually over forty.
ex.zh: 她看起來很年輕，但其實已經四十多歲了。

ex.en: However, the singer does not deny her ancestry.
ex.zh: 然而，這位歌手並不否認她的出身。

however.en: used to add a point that is different from what was just said

ex.en: However you do it, the result will be the same.
ex.zh: 無論你怎麼做，結果都一樣。

ex.en: Brush your teeth, however sleepy you are.
ex.zh: 不管多想睡，都要刷牙。

ex.en: Tom and Mary can do that however they like.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗想怎麼做就怎麼做。

however.en: in any way or to any degree

ex.en: I finished the work in less than an hour.
ex.zh: 我不到一小時就完成了這項工作。

ex.en: We must sleep at least eight hours a day.
ex.zh: 我們每天至少要睡八小時。

ex.en: It is an hour's drive from here to there.
ex.zh: 從這裡開車到那裡要一個小時。

ex.en: The workers complained when their working hours were extended.
ex.zh: 工時被延長時，工人們紛紛抱怨。

ex.en: Our office hours are from nine to six.
ex.zh: 我們的上班時間是九點到六點。

hour.en: the time when a person works or a place is open

ex.en: Tom was hoping the committee would adopt his proposal.
ex.zh: 湯姆希望委員會採納他的提案。

ex.en: Tom hopes you're able to attend his party.
ex.zh: 湯姆希望你能來參加他的派對。

ex.en: He had hoped to succeed, but he didn't.
ex.zh: 他原本希望能成功，但沒有。

hope.en: to want something to happen and think it may happen

ex.en: Don't give up hope.
ex.zh: 不要放棄希望。

ex.en: There is still hope that we can finish on time.
ex.zh: 我們還是有希望準時完成。

hope.en: a feeling that good things may happen

ex.en: There are many hotels in the city's business district.
ex.zh: 市區的商業區有很多飯店。

ex.en: You are allowed to use the hotel's swimming pool.
ex.zh: 你可以使用飯店的游泳池。

ex.en: Tom usually stays at five-star hotels.
ex.zh: 湯姆通常住五星級飯店。

hotel.en: a building where people pay to stay for a short time

ex.en: It's been hot this month, but today's an exception.
ex.zh: 這個月一直都很熱，但今天是個例外。

ex.en: Today is the hottest day this year.
ex.zh: 今天是今年最熱的一天。

ex.en: Draft beer tastes especially good on a hot day.
ex.zh: 大熱天喝生啤酒特別好喝。

ex.en: This curry is too hot for me.
ex.zh: 這咖哩對我來說太辣了。

ex.en: Do you like hot food?
ex.zh: 你喜歡吃辣嗎？

hot.en: having a strong, burning taste from spices

ex.en: Electric cars are a hot topic right now.
ex.zh: 電動車是目前的熱門話題。

ex.en: This phone is the hottest item this year.
ex.zh: 這款手機是今年最熱銷的商品。

hot.en: very popular and wanted by many people

ex.en: The boy rode a horse for the first time.
ex.zh: 男孩第一次騎馬。

ex.en: I rode a horse for the first time yesterday.
ex.zh: 我昨天第一次騎馬。

ex.en: All horses are animals, but not all animals are horses.
ex.zh: 所有的馬都是動物，但並非所有動物都是馬。

horse.en: a large animal that people ride and use for work

ex.en: He has patched up the hole in the wall.
ex.zh: 他把牆上的洞補好了。

ex.en: I've worn holes in my socks.
ex.zh: 我把襪子穿出洞來了。

ex.en: The runner jumped over the hole in the ground.
ex.zh: 那個跑者跳過地上的洞。

hole.en: an empty space or opening in a surface

ex.en: I felt that my honor was at stake.
ex.zh: 我覺得我的名譽岌岌可危。

ex.en: It's an honor to work with you.
ex.zh: 能和您共事是我的榮幸。

honor.en: a feeling of pride, or the respect people have for you

honor.zh: in honor of：為了紀念、向…致敬

ex.en: A farewell meeting was held in honor of Mr Jones.
ex.zh: 為瓊斯先生舉辦了一場歡送會。

ex.en: A dinner was held in honor of the retiring manager.
ex.zh: 為即將退休的經理舉辦了一場晚宴。

honor.en: in order to show respect for someone

ex.en: I am honored to meet you.
ex.zh: 能見到您是我的榮幸。

ex.en: I'm honored to be invited.
ex.zh: 能受邀我感到很榮幸。

honor.en: to give praise or respect to someone, or to make them feel proud

ex.en: The company will honor the warranty.
ex.zh: 公司會履行保固承諾。

ex.en: We always honor our agreements.
ex.zh: 我們一向遵守協議。

honor.en: to do what you promised or agreed to do

ex.en: He graduated from Harvard University with honors.
ex.zh: 他以優異的成績從哈佛大學畢業。

ex.en: He graduated from Cambridge with honors.
ex.zh: 他以優異的成績從劍橋大學畢業。

honor.en: with very high marks or a special prize

ex.en: More and more married couples share household chores.
ex.zh: 越來越多夫妻會分擔家務。

ex.en: She was busy with household work.
ex.zh: 她忙著做家事。

ex.en: Household appliances are on sale this week.
ex.zh: 家電本週特價。

household.en: relating to a home and the people living in it

ex.en: At least 20 households caught fire.
ex.zh: 至少有 20 戶人家發生火災。

ex.en: Almost every household has a TV.
ex.zh: 幾乎每個家庭都有電視。

household.en: all the people who live together in one home

ex.en: I am sure that he is an honest man.
ex.zh: 我確定他是個誠實的人。

ex.en: He's very honest, so we can rely on him.
ex.zh: 他非常誠實，所以我們可以信賴他。

honest.en: telling the truth and not cheating

ex.en: I don't like Tom very much, to be honest.
ex.zh: 老實說，我不太喜歡湯姆。

ex.en: To be honest, I want to study Japanese too.
ex.zh: 老實說，我也想學日文。

honest.en: used to say what you really think

ex.en: I've got my college interview tomorrow. Hopefully I'll pass.
ex.zh: 我明天有大學面試，希望能通過。

ex.en: Hopefully, we'll enjoy our China trip.
ex.zh: 希望我們的中國之旅會很愉快。

ex.en: Hopefully, we can all stay healthy.
ex.zh: 希望我們都能保持健康。

hopefully.en: used to say that you want something to happen

ex.en: Tom hung his shirt on a coat hook.
ex.zh: 湯姆把襯衫掛在衣帽鉤上。

ex.en: Hang your coat on the hook.
ex.zh: 把你的外套掛在鉤子上。

hook.en: a curved piece of metal or plastic for hanging things

ex.en: I hooked up the speakers to my laptop.
ex.zh: 我把喇叭接上了筆電。

ex.en: Can you help me hook up the new printer?
ex.zh: 你可以幫我把新印表機接好嗎？

hook.en: to connect a machine to another machine or power

ex.en: Betty got hooked on dancing.
ex.zh: 貝蒂迷上了跳舞。

ex.en: Many teenagers are hooked on video games.
ex.zh: 許多青少年沉迷於電玩。

hook.en: to like something so much that you cannot stop it

ex.en: I had a horrible dream last night.
ex.zh: 我昨晚做了一場噩夢。

ex.en: The weather yesterday was horrible.
ex.zh: 昨天的天氣糟透了。

ex.en: Tom made a horrible mistake.
ex.zh: 湯姆犯了一個很嚴重的錯誤。

ex.en: Only ticket holders may enter the hall.
ex.zh: 只有持票者可以進入大廳。

ex.en: The account holder must sign the form.
ex.zh: 帳戶持有人必須在表格上簽名。

holder.en: a person who has or owns something

ex.en: I put my phone in a phone holder in the car.
ex.zh: 我把手機放在車上的手機架上。

ex.en: There's a cup holder next to your seat.
ex.zh: 你座位旁邊有杯架。

holder.en: an object made to keep something in place

ex.en: Stress hormones can affect your sleep.
ex.zh: 壓力荷爾蒙會影響睡眠。

ex.en: Teenagers go through many hormone changes.
ex.zh: 青少年會經歷許多荷爾蒙變化。

hormone.en: a chemical made in the body that controls how it grows and works

ex.en: She housekeeps for an elderly couple three days a week.
ex.zh: 她每週三天幫一對老夫婦打理家務。

ex.en: He learned to cook and housekeep after moving out.
ex.zh: 他搬出去住以後學會了煮飯和做家事。

housekeep.en: to clean and take care of a home

ex.en: More and more couples go on honeymoon trips abroad.
ex.zh: 越來越多新婚夫妻出國度蜜月。

ex.en: We want to spend our honeymoon in Australia.
ex.zh: 我們想去澳洲度蜜月。

ex.en: A honeymoon in Canada costs a lot of money.
ex.zh: 去加拿大度蜜月要花很多錢。

honeymoon.en: a trip taken by two people who have just got married

honeymoon.zh: （比喻）蜜月期（初期的和諧階段）

ex.en: The new CEO's honeymoon period is over.
ex.zh: 新執行長的蜜月期結束了。

ex.en: The honeymoon with the new client didn't last long.
ex.zh: 跟新客戶的蜜月期沒有維持太久。

honeymoon.en: a short happy time at the start of a new job or relationship

ex.en: Is there a youth hostel near here?
ex.zh: 這附近有青年旅舍嗎？

ex.en: Is there a youth hostel around here?
ex.zh: 這一帶有沒有青年旅舍？

ex.en: Staying in a hostel is a cheap way to travel.
ex.zh: 住青年旅舍是省錢的旅行方式。

hostel.en: a cheap place where travelers can stay

ex.en: My hobby is taking pictures of wild flowers.
ex.zh: 我的嗜好是拍野花。

ex.en: My hobbies are driving and playing the guitar.
ex.zh: 我的嗜好是開車和彈吉他。

ex.en: His hobby is painting pictures of flowers.
ex.zh: 他的嗜好是畫花。

hobby.en: something you enjoy doing in your free time

ex.en: The fox hid in the hollow tree.
ex.zh: 狐狸躲在了空心樹裡面。

ex.en: I saw an old and hollow pecan tree that had some bees flying around it.
ex.zh: 我看到一棵老舊的空心山核桃樹，周圍有一些蜜蜂在飛。

ex.en: Bamboo is hollow inside.
ex.zh: 竹子的內部是中空的。

ex.en: My life is hollow without him.
ex.zh: 沒有他我的生活是空虛的。

ex.en: His promises sounded hollow to everyone.
ex.zh: 他的承諾聽起來空洞，大家都不相信。

hollow.en: without real meaning or true feeling

ex.en: This song makes me homesick.
ex.zh: 這首歌讓我想家了。

ex.en: I was so homesick.
ex.zh: 我很想家。

ex.en: I feel homesick.
ex.zh: 我想家了。

homesick.en: feeling sad because you are away from your family and house

ex.en: I feel hopeful about the future.
ex.zh: 我對未來感到有希望。

ex.en: The doctor was hopeful that she would recover soon.
ex.zh: 醫生對她很快康復抱有希望。

ex.en: We are hopeful about the future of the company.
ex.zh: 我們對公司的未來充滿希望。

hopeful.en: feeling that good things will happen

ex.en: The violent scenes in the film horrified the audience.
ex.zh: 電影中暴力的場面讓觀眾心驚膽戰。

ex.en: The news of the accident horrified everyone.
ex.zh: 意外的消息讓每個人都嚇壞了。

horrify.en: to make someone feel very shocked and afraid

ex.en: They look horrifying.
ex.zh: 他們看起來很可怕的。

ex.en: The photos from the disaster were horrifying.
ex.zh: 災難現場的照片令人毛骨悚然。

ex.en: It was a horrifying thought that he might never come home.
ex.zh: 想到他可能再也回不了家，真是可怕。

horrifying.en: making you feel very shocked and afraid

ex.en: He hurt his ankle and had to hop to the nurse's office.
ex.zh: 他扭傷了腳踝，只好單腳跳到保健室。

ex.en: The rabbit hopped across the garden.
ex.zh: 兔子蹦蹦跳跳地穿過花園。

hop.en: to jump on one foot, or to move with small jumps

ex.en: The children practiced a hop, skip and jump in the gym.
ex.zh: 孩子們在體育館練習三級跳。

ex.en: With one quick hop, the bird landed on the branch.
ex.zh: 那隻鳥輕輕一跳，就停在樹枝上。

hop.en: a small jump on one foot or both feet

ex.en: Because of the change in Canadian marriage laws, many American homosexuals came to Canada to get married.
ex.zh: 由於加拿大婚姻法的改變，所以很多美國同性戀者去了加拿大結婚。

ex.en: Almost all the American TV series of the last few years were written by homosexuals.
ex.zh: 這幾年的美劇幾乎都是由同性戀者編寫的。

ex.en: The law now protects homosexuals from discrimination at work.
ex.zh: 現在法律保障同性戀者在職場上不受歧視。

homosexual.en: a person who is attracted to people of the same sex

ex.en: They are homosexual.
ex.zh: 她們是同性戀。

ex.en: Taiwan was the first place in Asia to allow homosexual couples to marry.
ex.zh: 台灣是亞洲第一個允許同性伴侶結婚的地方。

ex.en: The book describes the life of a homosexual man in the 1950s.
ex.zh: 這本書描寫一位男同志在一九五〇年代的生活。

homosexual.en: attracted to people of the same sex
